text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Fuji-san! Did you come to visit 'Bono 
Diner'?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, word has spread, you know. They say 
you solve any trouble with your cooking.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I came by to see how things were going and 
grab a cup of coffee—and I'm glad to see 
you're enjoying yourself so much!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Now then... I need to put my 
thinking cap on.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai~! The next dorm social is next 
Friday, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm planning something truly special. 
Next time will be a night to remember—look 
forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~~ I can't wait~~! I wonder what 
special thing it'll be~~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—We've only been playing board games 
recently. I want to plan something truly 
extraordinary, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...A brilliant idea doesn't seem to strike 
quite so easily. I'll need to rack my 
brain a bit harder!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here you go, Fuji-san.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? What sweet is this...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I tried making panna cotta♪ Please enjoy 
it alongside your coffee~

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for such wonderful 
hospitality. I truly appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —! This is...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So light and refreshing...! Just the way I 
like it...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yay. I figured you'd prefer 
something that wasn't too sweet, Fuji-san.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ! You noticed... Fufu, could that secret—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps be written in that notebook you're 
holding?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ehehe~ Did you catch a glimpse 
inside?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I write notes in here about what makes 
everyone make that 'buono' face~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
For example, with you, Fuji-san, you often 
choose dark chocolate or low-sugar 
sweets... and things like that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, I tried serving a treat that would be 
easy for you to eat... and perfect for 
soothing your fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That is... an incredible amount of effort. 
A truly special notebook built up over 
time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...As I thought, bringing joy to others 
always requires something extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? You think so?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I only do it because I love doing it, so 
I've never really thought of it as 
'extraordinary'.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You see, I just love seeing everyone make 
that buono face!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If it's to see that, anything and 
everything is pure fun to me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ! ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—thank you, Akebono. It seems I had 
forgotten what truly matters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having wrapped up some work, I was walking 
across the main plaza when I bumped into 
Fuji Kiseki, who seemed to be in high 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... haha, was it written on my face? 
Actually, yes, it was.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There is this wonderful diner, you see. It 
has quite the reputation for solving 
people's troubles. If you ever find 
yourself at an impasse, you should pay it 
a visit!
choice_data_list: I think I might know that diner.
Were you able to solve something too?

text_block_list.text:
There is this wonderful diner, you see. It 
has quite the reputation for solving 
people's— If you ever find yourself at an 
impasse, you should pay it a visit!

Were you able to solve something too?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? You've heard the rumors as well?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps you have something troubling 
you? If you like, I would be delighted to 
escort you to "Diner Bono"♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I simply drew inspiration from their 
heartfelt hospitality, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—In all things, it is the "heart" that 
counts. I simply have to follow this wish 
to bring joy to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki spoke with delight. Her 
genuine feelings will surely reach 
everyone around her.
